q: Income earned but not yet received:
e: Income earned but not yet received — accrued income.

q: A market for short-term funds (up to one year):
e: A market for short-term funds (up to one year) — money market.

q: Management function that involves motivation and leadership:

q: A continuous rise in the general price level:

q: A deficit when total expenditure exceeds total receipts excluding borrowings:

q: The study of individual units like a firm or a household:

q: The father of economics:

q: The New Economic Policy of India was introduced in:

e: Goods whose demand falls when income rises — inferior goods.
